changes: Bounded evidence: retain the three furthest distinct oriented mappings per genome instead of rescanning all old interval records. At most two orientations can describe a single physical occurrence; a third covering mapping proves a repeat.

Packed DNA feeds SIMD minimizers and SSHash streaming directly; word-sized reads replace ASCII reconstruction and per-m-mer re-encoding. DNA checks remain exact and ambiguous-base boundaries remain explicit.
First-level exact aligned-interval cache before full hash and metadata lookups.
Preserve dictionary-only decoded bucket evidence at packed query jumps; invalidate position-dependent extension shortcuts and avoid duplicate resets.
Skip SIMD windows only when their shared minimizer is absent from the dictionary; independent tests check every omitted window.

Cross-proto skipping within established exact alignments, stopping before every repeated reference seed start; exact context-set equivalence checked against scanner with all new skips disabled. Compact scanner omits unused presence-mask collection; final reduction still requires all input genomes.

Bounded reference seed graphs: every strict all-genome MUM occurs in the reference, so a prefix graph retains complete seed coverage. Exact scans still validate all 512 documents. Subset thresholds and reusable states keep full graph coverage.

v24.construction: A normalized oriented adjacency edge uses each distinct endpoint occurrence at most once. Equal complete group and edge counts prove a bijection of all reference copies; only these full-key matches coalesce a class. Conflicting physical groups stay conservative.
v24.scanning: Unresolved right contexts emit no arbitrary sample alignment. A sample compares exact DNA only within the proven class span and the reference/query DNA runs. New class entries and mismatch-crossing windows are visited.
